wiki.title: Christine Drazan
wiki.extract: Christine Renee Drazan (née Deboy, born 1972) is an American politician who serves in the Oregon State Senate from the 26th district as a member of the Republican Party. Prior to her tenure in the state senate she was a member of the Oregon House of Representatives from the 39th and 51st districts. She was minority leader in the state house from 2019 to 2021, and in 2025.
